name: Nalinee Chaiyawat
bio:
Nalinee's analytical journey began during her engineering studies at Chulalongkorn University. Initially drawn to the precision of data analysis in manufacturing, she discovered motorsport through a university club, captivated by the real-time data demands of racing. After graduating, she worked as a junior analyst for a logistics company, honing her skills in data mining and statistical modeling. Eager to apply her abilities to racing, she joined Academy Motorsport last year.

Her approach involves a blend of traditional statistical methods and cutting-edge machine learning techniques. Nalinee is known for her ability to distill complex datasets into actionable insights for the race engineers and drivers. She believes in collaborative problem-solving, working closely with other team members to identify performance bottlenecks and develop data-driven solutions. Her attention to detail and proactive communication make her a valuable asset to Academy Motorsport.

What sets Nalinee apart is her commitment to continual learning. She actively follows the latest research in data science and motorsport technology, seeking opportunities to improve her skills and contribute to the team's competitive edge. She is particularly interested in predictive modeling for race strategy and tire management.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often pulled back in a high ponytail during work
physical.description: Nalinee is of average height with a slender build and a warm, friendly smile.

quirks: Always has a cup of Thai iced tea on her desk, regardless of the weather.
Uses color-coded sticky notes to organize her data visualizations, even for personal notes.
Often hums quietly while analyzing data, a habit she claims helps her concentrate.
